description: Signed status credentials on x402 sellers, $0.001 each, for registries, gateways and agent hosts that cache and embed a seller's standing: a live re-read of each seller's offer against its listing (asked what it lists, asked more, named another pay-to, OFAC, no answer), signed as a W3C credential that lasts 24 hours. Over HTTP a re-check while they hold is a free 304. The rules are free at /v1/status/contents. credentials picks the most credentials issued, and the price. Price: credentials=1 $0.001; credentials=10 $0.01; credentials=100 $0.10; credentials=1000 $1.00, in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call; the 402 states the one price of what the arguments ask for. Over HTTP, each choice is its own route at the same price, which any x402 client pays without MCP: /mcp/tools lists them. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges that price to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

credentials.description: The most credentials to issue, which sets the price: 1 for $0.001, 10 for $0.01, 100 for $0.10, 1000 for $1.00
credentials.title: Credentials

hosts.description: The sellers, by host (api.example.com) or by any URL on it. Each is read live at its busiest listing on the newest Bazaar snapshot, at most once an hour whoever asks
hosts.title: Hosts

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
